cadence.desc: A doubly-colored close: the descending turnaround (iv–iii–ii–V7) is followed by the borrowed bVI and a backdoor bVII7 — two color chords in a row before the tonic lands. Unusual even for barbershop; the bVI→bVII7→I “double backdoor” is worth a name of its own: the “Two-Door Finish”.

harmonic_walk: iv → iii → ii → V7 → bVI → bVII7 → I turnaround sweep, then a I hanger with a chromatic #ii° slip (Bb over G = bIII color) — the “heart-melt” bVI before the home stretch is the signature barbershop sweeper; the bVII7→I is a backdoor resolution.

cadence.desc: The tag modulates to the relative-minor territory for the ending and closes with a backdoor bVII7 → i — blues-tinged and distinctly unclassical; combined with the preceding ii7 color it’s a minor-mode backdoor close.

harmonic_walk: Song is in D major but the tag restates it in B minor (barbershop key-flip for the ending); oscillates i–V7 then IV7–bVI–VII7 color chain, ii°-half-dim slips, and finishes i–ii7–VII7–i… ends with VII7→i backdoor into the minor tonic.

cadence.desc: An unusual chromatic slide: a chain of secondary leading-tone diminished 7ths (ii°7/C = A°7, II7/C# = A7, vii°7/D) climbs by half-steps into the minor tonic — barbershop arrangers call this family of moves a “chromatic parsec”; it lands without a plain V–I.

harmonic_walk: Long tag with a cycle of ii7 color chords, then V7 → bIII → #i°7 → V7/A chromatic climb resolving to i; ends via ii°7/C → II7/C# → vii°7/D chain — a rising chromatic “climb to the post” into the tonic.

cadence.desc: The subdominant arrives carrying a dominant 7th (IV7) — the blues-inflected plagal close; in barbershop this IV7→I with the 7th on top is sometimes called the “glorified Amen”.

harmonic_walk: Extremely chromatic tag (the bb-romans earlier); ends IV7 → I — a dominant-seventh subdominant (“bluesy plagal”) close.

cadence.desc: An unusual chromatic approach: a raised-fifth diminished sonority (#v°/D#) sits a half-step under the final tonic, then resolves — a “slip cadence” where the last chord is approached purely chromatically, no functional dominant at all.

harmonic_walk: Entirely I and ii7 for most of the tag (plagal hovering), then a #v°/D# chromatic slip (Bbm over D#) before the final D — a Picardy-like major ending after minor hovering.
